key_insight: ReactNexus discovers kinetically informed chemical reaction networks from reactant graphs alone, without predefined products or reaction templates.
engineering_relevance: The framework can support reaction-mechanism analysis by identifying lower-barrier pathways, competing catalytic branches, and candidate structures for mass-spectral interpretation.
method: Generate candidate transition states and full reaction trajectories from reactant graphs.
Use a machine-learned interatomic potential to verify connectivity and evaluate electronic barriers.
Expand reaction networks with kinetic guidance to explore accessible intermediates and pathways.
evidence_signal: On an in-distribution benchmark of 10,000 generated candidates, 80.8% connected to the input reactant after DFT optimization and intrinsic reaction coordinate verification.
watch_item: The reported connectivity benchmark is in-distribution and does not establish accuracy or network completeness for unfamiliar chemistry.
paper_title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
